objective: Compute BESS active and reactive ancillary-service response to frequency and voltage disturbances.

title.ru: REL-TASK-004 — Реакция BESS по P/Q для вспомогательных услуг

objective.en: Apply frequency and voltage droop rules to produce BESS P/Q commands within inverter and SOC constraints.
objective.ru: Применить частотные и напряженческие droop-правила для получения команд P/Q BESS с учётом ограничений инвертора и SOC.

instructions.en: Use bess_response_case. For each measurement timestamp, compute active power from frequency droop and reactive power from voltage droop. Positive P discharges to the grid. Clip P by charge/discharge limits and Q by apparent-power capability after P. Update SOC over the interval and report p_response_mw, q_response_mvar, and final_soc_mwh.
instructions.ru: Используйте bess_response_case. Для каждого момента вычислите активную мощность по частотному droop и реактивную мощность по напряженческому droop. Положительное P означает разряд в сеть. Ограничьте P по пределам заряда/разряда и Q по полной мощности с учётом P. Обновите SOC за интервал и укажите p_response_mw, q_response_mvar и final_soc_mwh.

public_inputs.calculation_spec: For each timestamp, compute p_response_mw = clip((nominal_frequency_hz - frequency_hz) * frequency_droop_mw_per_hz, -p_charge_limit_mw, p_discharge_limit_mw). Then compute q_response_mvar = clip((target_voltage_pu - voltage_pu) * voltage_droop_mvar_per_pu, +/- sqrt(s_rating_mva^2 - p_response_mw^2)). Positive P discharges the battery; update SOC over interval_seconds with the supplied efficiencies.

submission_schema.p_response_mw: object mapping timestamp to active-power response
submission_schema.q_response_mvar: object mapping timestamp to reactive-power response

hard_constraints: P response must follow frequency droop with charge/discharge clipping.
Q response must follow voltage droop clipped by apparent-power capability after P.
Final SOC must match the independent simulation within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether submitted BESS response satisfies all hard constraints.
